newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia shakes up management structure.
newsitem.headline: Iberia shakes up management structure.

text.p: Spain's state-owned airline Iberia said on Wednesday it had reorganised its management structure as part of a shake-up initiated by newly appointed chairman Xabier de Irala.

Iberia said it had created a new general division which would control the day-to-day running of the company, incorporating those activities previously controlled by the registrar and the corporate and production divisions.
In a statement, the carrier said it had also created a new strategy planning and alliance division which would deal with medium- and long-term planning.
"This is an area that we will be focusing on during the coming months and in which I will be personally involved," Irala was quoted as saying in the statement.
Irala, who took office in July, promised earlier this month that the airline would undergo wide-ranging reforms. "A lot of things are going to change at Iberia," he told journalists.
